prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A dreamy, ethereal forest scene at dawn, softly lit with diffused golden sunlight filtering through misty trees in the background. In the foreground, two majestic wolves face each other in profile, their fur rendered in delicate shades of white and pale gray, with subtle hints of cream and silver. The wolves’ expressions are calm and contemplative, their eyes reflecting a gentle intelligence. The overall color palette is muted and pastel, dominated by soft greens, blues, and warm yellows, creating a tranquil, almost surreal atmosphere. The composition is symmetrical, with the wolves positioned on either side of the frame, drawing the viewer’s gaze to the center. The image has a painterly, almost fantasy-like quality, with a shallow depth of field that blurs the background and emphasizes the wolves. Superimposed at the top and center of the image is bold, serif text reading, “Inside you there are two wolves,” while a second, glowing line of text below the wolves reads, “You are being spitroasted at a furry convention.” The overall style is reminiscent of a whimsical, high-fantasy illustration with a touch of surreal humor.
